findings.text: blocking: baseline_suite and after_suite are written as prose ('{"arm: base, rev: ...}') rather than the declared JSON object, so reckon/crew/reports.py:913 _parse_suite_observation returns a string; reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1936 _head_suite_failure_ids then reads None and :1896 _baseline_suite_failure_ids reads an empty set, so the negative-control comparison at :2072-2088 runs against a baseline that 'failed nothing' and admits each control on an arm that was never measured -- exactly the vacuous admission the function's own docstring warns of -- and the suite-delta reader at promotion_evidence.py:1195-1219 finds no arm at all. Neither field carries the required 'completed' or 'failure_ids' keys; the ids exist only in the arm logs.

follow-on: the header names revision ecd22bbd7 (the base) while the tree it measured is the head worktree at 2419ab03b, and logs/new-test.log:1 and both logs/negcontrol-*.log:1 carry the same base revision although tests/test_a_reserved_lane_reads_its_published_window.py exists only at head; 54 requires every log to start with its revision, and the header is inconsistent within the run because logs/head-arm-2.log:1 and logs/module-window.log:1 do name head, so a reader cannot tell from the header which revision the 9-passing run and the two red controls were taken at.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from ecd22bbd7 to 2419ab03b, a single commit: it adds fill_window_clock to pace_report.py and makes pace_row call it, rewrites the picker's window term to read through it, and replaces the credits-only lift release with any-lift release resolved in candidates, beside a 476-line test and the evidence fragment.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is lane-and-model-routing 54: nine test cases, two negative controls, no added failure against a base arm under -n 8, tests/test_every_module_fits_a_worker_window.py passes at head, and a clean ruff pair; logs/new-test.log records 9 passed EXIT=0, logs/negcontrol-operative-fallback.log (4 failed) and logs/negcontrol-credits-only.log (2 failed) are red as declared, and logs/ruff.log is CHECK_EXIT=0 FORMAT_EXIT=0, but the module-window clause is unmet: logs/module-window.log is 1 failed/3 passed on reckon/roadmap.py, identical at base in logs/module-window-base.log.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is to make the picker's reserved-lane window term read the window the lane's account publishes and release the window term under any lift in force for the pick's session; reckon/pace_report.py:322 adds fill_window_clock, reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1245 _reserved_fill_window_utilisation reads through it, and :1611 resolves lift_in_force from _effective_budget_block for request.session.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it states commit 2419ab03b, the 9-passing new test, both negative controls with their red counts and first failing ids, four arm runs with their failure ids, the ruff pair, and it discloses the pre-existing module-window failure and the -n 8 flake; its baseline_suite and after_suite lines (manifest.md:20-21) are prose, not the declared JSON object.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the source run's fence grants reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py, reckon/pace_report.py, tests/test_a_reserved_lane_reads_its_published_window.py, docs/evidence/fragments/lane-and-model-routing/reserved-lane-reads-published-window.html and a figures directory; git diff --stat ecd22bbd7..2419ab03b changes exactly the first four, all inside the grant, and the figures path is unused.

justifications.durability: the nine cases assert the candidate output set (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1595-1630) and the row's clock mapping at reckon/pace_report.py:367 rather than the values handed in, and logs/negcontrol-operative-fallback.log (4 failed) and logs/negcontrol-credits-only.log (2 failed) show each reinstated defect reddens a named case.
justifications.evidence: logs/new-test.log records 9 passed with EXIT=0 and both controls are red, but logs/module-window.log fails the 54 clause that the module-window test passes at head, and manifest.md:20-21 records its two arms as prose the promotion readers at reckon/crew/promotion_checks.py:1896,1936 cannot parse.
justifications.fit: reckon/pace_report.py:322-378 follows the module's clock-dict and deferred-import idiom and introduces no plan, ticket or version identifier in any name or comment.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/pace_report.py:322 fill_window_clock is the one reader both pace_row (:1770) and the two picker sites (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1265, :1625) call, and snapshot.py:1611 resolves whether any lift governs for the pick's session.
justifications.reuse: fill_window_clock is the sole owner of the allowance-to-clock fallback -- a repository search found no second copy and pace_row's inline block was deleted -- but candidates resolves _effective_budget_block twice per reserved candidate (reckon/crew/picker/snapshot.py:1562 and :1611).
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat ecd22bbd7..2419ab03b touches only the four granted paths and carries nothing the goal does not imply.
